Artist Bios

Day Drinkers

Matt Martin is the leader of the crowd favorite, The Day Drinkers. Matt and his guest musician for the night offers a collection of music from Neil Young to The Beatles to Jimmy Buffet. A high energy duo. Matt is a member of the highly acclaimed Neil Vitullo and Friends band. #daydrinkersofficial 


Dylan Wheaton

The Allman Brothers x Bob Dylan. One of the best acoustic acts on the South Shore. Dylan just finished performing for Acoustic Barn Series tour. His collection includes originals with covers of the legends of country rock and blues. #dgw_acoustic / dgwacoustic.com


Merrick Brannigan

Merrick Brannigan is a singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist. Following sessions at Grand Street Recording in Brooklyn, NY, he released his debut EP The Breeze in September of 2024. He is rooted in Folk Pop, Indie and rock. #merrickbrannigan / merrickbranigan.com


Valerie Barretto

Valerie released her debut original album, Hurt & Healing, in September 2022. The album’s success led to two award nominations in 2023: “Rising Star: Massachusetts” at the New England Music Awards and “Country Act of the Year” at the Boston Music Awards. In August 2024, Valerie released her second record, The Lucky Ones EP, which earned her three separate award nominations, including Song of the Year for her standout single, “Rattlesnake Road". #valeriebarrettomusic / valeriebarrettomusic.com


Somethin’ Else Duo

Dave Grew on Piano & Vocals and Susan Sylvia on Lead Vocals make up this duo covering rock, pop, country & classic rock. A New Bedford and Fall River favorite. #somethinelseduo


Stefan Couture

Stefan Couture is a Rhode Island-based singer-songwriter with a modern folk style. In recognition of his talent, Stefan was nominated for Motif Magazine R.I.'s Best Singer/Songwriter 2022 and Best Americana Vocalist 2024. #stefancouturemusic / stefancouture.com


John Chebator

John is a Country, Blues and R&B guitar singer songwriter from Kingston, MA. He is the lead guitar player of Nashville country star Ashley Jordan, putting him in the category of one of the best country and country blues lead guitar players from New England. #johnchebator / johnchebator.com


Neal McCarthy Duo

Without a doubt, New Bedford’s most recognized music personalities. Neal and his high energy fusion band recently sold out the 450 seat Narrows Center for The Arts venue. He is joined by the award winning Australian fiddle player, Mark Russell. #neal.t.mccarthy / mccarthyneal12.wixsite.com


Chris Fitz

Chris Fitz is a hotpot of blues jambalaya, mixing swing, jump, Chicago and Texas blues styles with a healthy dose of funk, soul, rock-n-roll, and a touch of British blues rock. Chris is the Boston Music Award winner in the Best Blues Guitarist category and won The Boston Blues Challenge awarding him a spot in the Memphis Blues Challenge to challenge the countries best blues acts. chrisfitzband.com
